tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Tokens Stoa lists on a network, with address, symbol and decimals, plus the router address. Any other token address can still be quoted, but treat it as unverified and run safety_check first.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Compare every venue Stoa routes for this exact amount and return the route it would fill: amountOut (after Stoa's 2 bps fee), minOut for the slippage, price impact and the venues. Read-only.

tools.name: build_swap
tools.description: Same as quote, plus the unsigned transaction (to, data, value, chainId) for the taker's wallet to sign, and the approval it needs first when selling a token. Stoa never signs or sends anything.

tools.name: safety_check
tools.description: Simulate a small buy and an immediate sell-back of a token through Stoa's live router (eth_call, nothing sent), and read how concentrated its supply is. Returns verdict ok | caution | danger | unknown, buy and sell tax, round-trip cost, creator and top-10 holdings. A pass describes the token today;

tools.name: bridge_quote
tools.description: Move ETH, USDC or USDT from Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Optimism or BNB Chain to the same wallet on Robinhood Chain (arriving as ETH or USDG), through LI.FI over Across. tools.name: stock_tokens
tools.description: Robinhood Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain: Robinhood's price for the underlying stock next to the on-chain price, liquidity, 24h volume and whether Stoa can route a swap. Optionally filter by ticker.

tools.description: Robinhood Stock Tokens whose on-chain price is furthest from Robinhood's own price right now: cheaper or dearer on-chain, among pools with real liquidity that actually trade (pools with under $100 of 24h volume and gaps over 25% are left out as stale). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_payment_link · Private data: list_tokens, build_swap, safety_check, bridge_quote, market_context, stock_tokens, stock_gaps, spotlight, create_payment_link, pay_payment_link · Public sink: spotlight · Destructive: list_tokens, spotlight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_payment_link · Private data: list_tokens, build_swap, safety_check, bridge_quote, market_context, stock_tokens, stock_gaps, spotlight, create_payment_link, pay_payment_link · Public sink: spotlight · Destructive: list_tokens, spotlight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "spotlight" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
